summary: Grupo Cibest S.A., a Colombian bank holding company, filed a Form 6-K disclosing shareholder-approved extraordinary dividend. The shareholders' meeting approved reallocating COP 1,200,665,358,786 from the specific reserve to pay a COP 1,271 per share dividend on September 1, 2026. Based on 508,474,753 common and 436,187,213 preferred shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, total payout is COP 1.2 trillion. Ex-dividend period runs August 27-September 1, 2026, subject to Bolsa de Valores de Colombia adjustment. An ongoing share buyback may reduce outstanding shares; dividends on repurchased shares will be suspended and revert to reserve. Management confirmed meeting procedures and board authorization. Watch for buyback impact on total payout and ex-dividend date adjustments.
